What sets us apart is our commitment to excellence and our passion for the work we do. About The Opportunity

As a potential Capital Planning Analyst, this role will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with a talented team of professionals in support of our client. This potential role is responsible for ensuring CPIC processes are accurate and compliant, which is reflective in the FPAC IT Portfolio health scores. Join us and be part of our mission to make a difference!

Some Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To

Develops and validates business cases, artifacts and data supporting investment health, performance and departmental reviews.
Analyzes spend plan and contract data to correctly align investment projects.
Ensures EVM approaches align with traditional and agile development models.
Drafts AAR Cover Memos and completes AAR shells in AgMAX 2.0.

Minimum Qualifications

2+ years of CPIC experience with federal programs. USDA experience preferred.

Knowledge of Earned Value Management (project performance measurement, forecasting, and variance analysis).
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including business and technical writing skills.

You will develop an engagement strategy that meets each client’s planning needs. Through your integrity and adherence to Fidelity’s client commitment standards, we know you will inspire client dedication with a goal of developing lifetime relationships with Fidelity.

The Planning Consultant conducts joint client appointments and is passionate about delivering personalized financial consultations through Fidelity’s offerings. Through education and personalized planning, the role helps identify opportunities that support clients' long-term financial success. You will be creating and maintaining an organized client contact strategy, engaging business partners and using tools such as Salesforce, as well as building long-lasting, meaningful relationships with clients. Additionally, the role promotes a collaborative environment by mentoring and supporting fellow associates.

The Expertise And Skills You Bring

FINRA Series 7 & 66 licensed and hold appropriate state registrations, OR ability to acquire Series 66 upon hire
Minimum 2 years of financial services or relevant experience
Attainment of CFP® Certification is highly encouraged

Ability to profile to understand planning needs and identify appropriate solutions
Vested interest in building relationships and being an advocate for clients
Motivated toward success, willing to demonstrate ownership, and committed to achieving meaningful goals
Comfortable making outbound calls to further educate clients and uncover opportunities

The Team

The Planning Consultant works alongside the Financial Consultant or Wealth Planner to deliver financial planning support. This role expands upon the planning capabilities available to engage Fidelity’s most valuable clients. In addition to the primary responsibility of conducting financial planning interactions, the role supports the overall client relationship by leveraging innovative technologies, such as Glance, to enhance the client experience. jobs.description:
About The Role

Intapp Properties is the system of record for real estate teams managing land acquisition, development, and asset workflows. As an Implementation Consultant, you own the client onboarding journey from kickoff through go-live — building the relationship, configuring the platform, and turning each client’s bespoke real estate processes into a working system they trust. This role sits at the intersection of consulting, product expertise, and real estate domain knowledge. You’ll be the client’s primary guide and advocate, and the person accountable for a successful, on-time launch.

What You’ll Do

Manage the overall client onboarding journey — plan and run kickoff, discovery, configuration, testing, training, and go-live, keeping stakeholders aligned on scope and timeline.

Own and manage the client relationship — serve as the primary point of contact, build trust with executives and end users, and drive adoption well past launch.

Configure the client’s system of record based on industry best practices — objects, fields, calculations, approval workflows, reporting, and folder structures that reflect how leading real estate firms operate.

Translate bespoke real estate processes into the platform — model each client’s unique acquisition, development, and investment workflows in Intapp Properties without losing what makes their process work.

Lead discovery and requirements sessions to document current-state processes, data sources, and approval chains.

Coordinate data migration and integrations with client teams and internal engineering.  Deliver training and enablement so client teams are self-sufficient at go-live.

Feed client insight back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.

What You’ll Bring

2+ years in real estate development / finance, software implementation, solutions consulting, or client onboarding — ideally in commercial real estate, homebuilding, or proptech.

Working knowledge of real estate workflows: land acquisition, due diligence, entitlement, development budgets, investment committee approvals, or asset management.

Experience configuring SaaS platforms (CRM, deal management, or project management systems); comfort with structured data, formulas, or light scripting is a plus.

Strong project management instincts — you keep multiple onboardings moving and flag risk early.

Clear, confident communication with audiences from analysts to executives.

A consultative mindset: you ask why before you build, and you push back with best practices when a request would create long-term pain.

jobs.description:
Are you ready for what’s next?

Come explore opportunities within Brunswick, a global marine leader committed to challenging conventions and innovating next-generation technologies that transform experiences on the water and beyond. Brunswick believes “Next Never Rests™,” and we offer a variety of exciting careers and growth opportunities within united teams defining the future of marine recreation.

Location: Fond du Lac, WI

Workplace Category: Hybrid

Travel Required: None

Direct Reports: None

$73,600 - $106,200

Visa Sponsorship: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Relocation: No

Innovation is the heart of Brunswick. See how your contributions will help transform vision into reality:

Position Overview

As part of the talented Demand Planning team, the Senior Demand Planning Analyst is responsible for leading the development and management of an 18-month rolling demand plan for Mercury propulsion products as a critical input into the company's integrated Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process. This role serves as a key business partner across Sales, Product Management, Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to translate market intelligence, customer trends, and business strategies into actionable demand forecasts.

The Senior Demand Planning Analyst drives forecast accuracy, identifies demand risks and opportunities, facilitates cross-functional alignment, and provides strategic insights that support business growth, inventory optimization, and operational decision-making. The role also leads continuous improvement initiatives and advances forecasting methodologies.

At Brunswick, we have passion for our work and a distinct ability to deliver.

Essential Functions

Lead the development, validation, and maintenance of demand forecasts for assigned propulsion product families and customer channels by integrating statistical models, market intelligence, macroeconomic indicators, commercial strategies, financial plans, customer insights, and new product introductions.
Own the monthly demand planning process, facilitating cross-functional discussions to achieve alignment on volume, mix, timing, assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Analyze demand trends, forecast performance, and key business drivers to provide actionable recommendations to leadership and key stakeholders.
Develop and present demand planning insights, scenarios, and recommendations to support executive decision-making within the SIOP process.
Partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Finance, and Operations teams to improve forecast visibility and strengthen demand signal quality.
Lead forecast performance reviews, including analysis of forecast accuracy, bias, and error metrics, while driving corrective actions to improve results.
Proactively identify emerging market trends, customer shifts, and business risks that may impact demand and develop mitigation strategies.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the forecasting and demand planning process through advanced analytics, automation, and Lean Six Sigma methodologies.
Act as a subject matter expert for demand planning systems, tools, and processes, supporting organizational capability development and adoption of enhanced forecasting techniques.

Diversity of thought and experiences is fundamental when imagining the unimaginable. Certain skillsets/experiences are necessary; however, others can be developed along the way.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field (Supply Chain, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Marketing, Market Research, or similar discipline).
4+ years of progressive experience in demand planning, supply chain planning, forecasting, analytics, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional planning processes and influencing decisions across multiple levels of an organization.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience translating complex data into business insights and recommendations.
Advanced communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with proven ability to facilitate alignment among diverse teams.
Experience utilizing statistical forecasting techniques and interpreting forecast performance metrics.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and business intelligence/reporting tools.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

CPIM, CSCP, CPF, or APICS certification.
Experience with Oracle, Demantra, SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or other demand planning and forecasting platforms.
Experience leading forecasting transformation, process improvement, or planning system implementation initiatives.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent continuous improvement experience.
Passion for boating and/or interest in marine propulsion systems.

The anticipated pay range for this position is $73,600 - $106,200 annually. The actual base pay offered will vary depending on multiple factors including job- related knowledge/skills, relevant experience, business needs, and geographic location. In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

You will be responsible for the overall service relationship and essential for driving technology services adoption, ensuring customer retention, and maximizing the lifetime value of customers by guiding them through onboarding, customer satisfaction and helping them achieve their business goals throughout the contract term. The CSC actively translates client feedback into service improvements while surfacing opportunities for expansion.

Your Impact

The Essential Functions Of This Position Include

Onboarding & Implementation: Responsible for the end-to-end onboarding engagement process for new customers, hosting kick-off meetings, conducting educational sessions, and ensuring a seamless, rapid transition to a fully operational, high-value state.
Support & Advocacy: Serves as the first-line escalation support for issues, escalating complex problems to the appropriate teams, and acting as the voice of the customer internally. Proactive Relationship Management: Takes ownership of the end-to-end customer experience for managed services, acting as the primary point of contact. The services managed by the CSC are mainly reactive in nature, but the CSC will maintain regular, proactive engagement to monitor sentiment, ensure high satisfaction, and build loyal relationships, reducing churn risk. Problem Resolution and Process Optimization: Provide expert problem resolution support for difficult customer issues, including root cause analysis and driving corrective action plans. Translates client feedback into actionable service improvements, utilizing Customer Success tools and ticketing systems to document and enhance the customer journey.
Reporting & CRM Management: Maintains accurate customer records in the Customer Success system (e.g., ChurnZero) and Ticketing system (e.g., ServiceNow), while providing updates to those who maintain the CRM system (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics 365) and the Project Management system (e.g., Open Air.) Prepare weekly/bi-weekly/monthly/quarterly health reports for internal stakeholders. Analyze customer account revenue trends and manage revenue collection and cost.
Team Culture: We believe in building a strong and supportive team culture that is founded on the principles of collaboration, empathy, and open communication. As a member of our team, you can expect to work in an environment that:
Encourages emotional intelligence, resilience, and effective communication
Values diversity, inclusivity, and compassion
Supports your growth and development as a professional

1-3 years of experience in a customer-facing role (Customer Success, Client Services, Account Management, or Technical Support), preferably within an IT services or managed services environment
Experience supporting services in complex and high-profile customer environments
Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Cisco Webex, and Microsoft Teams
Strong understanding of IT infrastructure and services, including networking, business communications, security, wireless, SAN, and server management.
Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to build relationships with technical and executive stakeholders
Strong customer service, active listening, and client relationship management skills
Demonstrated analytical skills with the ability to monitor account health, usage metrics, and reporting
Results-oriented with high emotional intelligence and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment
Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications or related field and/or relevant professional experience

Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working with or for an IT managed Services organization
Experience with Cisco Webex and Microsoft Teams for conducting virtual meetings
Experience with data analytics tools (Tableau, etc.)

Position Specifics

The initial base salary range for this position is expected to be between $45,000 and $60,000 annually. The final base salary offered will be determined by multiple factors, including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, depth of experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Summary

At Aptiv Interconnect, we inspire the world’s most innovative teams by doing the right thing, the right way. We are seeking a detail-oriented and collaborative professional dedicated seamless production flow as a Junior planner. The primary purpose of this role is to ensure materials are available or on order in the quantities and timeframes needed to meet production and customer requirements, while providing material planning, manufacturing, and purchasing support across operations.

By bridging material planning with broader business strategy, this role ensures operational agility and alignment with long-term company objectives. You will collaborate cross-functionally to optimize production workflows, directly enhancing our delivery capabilities and fostering a culture of operational excellence. Your contributions will be pivotal in maintaining consistent product availability, which is fundamental to achieving our overall growth and customer satisfaction goals.

Operational Execution

Material Requirement Planning: Review customer demand and inventory levels to ensure materials are available in precise quantities, maintaining seamless production flow and meeting delivery commitments.
Production Readiness: Identify shortages and inventory discrepancies early to proactively resolve issues, preventing production delays and protecting the manufacturing schedule.
Maintain accurate planning and material data within the ERP system to provide a reliable "single source of truth," supporting better business decisions and operational agility.

Supply Chain Coordination

Procurement Support: Assist Purchasing in creating and monitoring purchase orders to secure timely supplier commitments, directly reducing lead-time risks for critical components.
Shortage Management: Follow up on past-due materials and escalate risks to management to ensure transparent supply chain visibility and prompt mitigation of potential customer impact.
Integrated Problem Solving: Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, and Engineering to resolve complex material issues, fostering a culture of excellence and alignment with company objectives.

Industry Domain: Strong foundational knowledge of manufacturing operations, including understanding of Bills of Materials (BOM), production scheduling, and inventory control processes; familiarity with build-to-order environments is highly preferred
Regulatory Compliance: Citizenship, or other legal/export control requirements apply.

Core Competencies: Analytical thinking, attention to detail, effective communication, problem solving and adaptability, time management and prioritization, and technical proficiency.

At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

As a Customer Success Manager, AKA "Agent Experience Manager" you are the first person our customers meet when they join Compass and will be their account manager from that day forward. You will support our customers with everything including but not limited to understanding Compass, training on our tools and programs, assisting with marketing requests and more. As an AEM you are passionate about your customers and delivering a world class experience.

Note: This role is 100% in office out of our Coconut Grove Office (2550 South Bayshore Drive).

At Compass You Will

Manage a portfolio of high-touch customers by serving as their day-to-day contact for questions and issues via phone calls, emails, and in-person meetings
Promote the adoption of Compass technology and adjacent services by providing customers with 1:1 support, strategic recommendations, and group training sessions
Provide essential marketing support by answering questions, creating collateral from templates including listing presentations and postcards, and being the liaison to marketing specialists for more complex support requests
Partner with the Onboarding team on strategy and logistics for welcoming new customers to Compass
Support ongoing projects such as new office openings, national initiatives, and new Expansion/M&A activity
Work collaboratively with other team members and departments to champion questions and feedback on behalf of the agent
Serve as the face of the office by welcoming guests, answering the office phone line, managing mail distribution, providing first-line support for office-related needs; assisting with the overall appearance and organization of the office, maintaining supply inventory, and escalating facilities issues.

What We're Looking For:

2-3 years of experience in customer service, training, office management, hospitality, or operations
Previous experience in real estate a plus
Previous experience with live or remote training a plus
Previous experience working with enterprise technology (Zendesk, Salesforce, Confluence) a plus
Passion for supporting and serving agents trying to grow their businesses
The ability to establish credibility with key agent decision-makers and influencers
Great listening skills, connects well with others, and is empathetic of the customer’s pain points
A passion for creating community within a space; you encourage in-office interaction, bonding and engagement
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, allowing you to adapt and formulate solutions quickly
Skilled communicator with great interpersonal skills, ability to build and manage relationships
Meticulous attention to detail, highly organized
Strong creative writing skills and eye for design
Ability to work in the office during standard operating hours
Ability to lift up to 25 lbs

Perks That You Need To Know About

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

About The Role

One Legal, an InfoTrack company, is seeking an experienced Customer Success Manager who lives our company values of customer-centricity, striving for ambitious goals, and respect for colleagues and clients. In this role, you will play a key part in driving revenue growth and increasing client retention to support long-term loyalty across the One Legal client base.

As a Customer Success Manager, you are responsible for playing a key role in driving revenue growth and increasing client retention to ensure long-term loyalty of the One Legal client base. It is important that in this role you drive customer-centricity, striving for ambitious goals centered around increasing revenue. Strong sales acumen with demonstrated experience proactively outbounding into existing accounts to identify growth opportunities, uncover unmet needs, and drive expansion revenue. It is important that as a Customer Success Manager, you are able to build and maintain strong customer relationships. You must be able to thrive in a fast-paced environment while demonstrating high energy, optimism, and executive presence that inspires clients and drives momentum.

This role is ideal for candidates who enjoy combining customer success with sales-driven growth, thrive in an energetic, in-office environment, and are comfortable with proactive outbound engagement

This is a full-time, base salary plus commission, hybrid position based out of our San Francisco office with regular in-office presence required 3 days a week. Most work is conducted via phone and video, with in-office collaboration as part of the hybrid schedule. The role may also require occasional travel to company-sponsored events and conferences approximately 3-6 times per year.

The starting base salary range for this role is $66,960-$83,700. In addition, this role is eligible for an annual target commission of $45,000, with total compensation determined based on experience, qualifications, and internal pay equity.

About One Legal, An InfoTrack Company

One Legal, a division of InfoTrack, is a one-stop online solution for legal professionals to file court documents in every California court, manage service of process nationwide, and more. A leader in innovative technology solutions for legal professionals for more than 30 years, One Legal continues to be among the most respected in the industry.

As a highly ambitious company, we know that our people are critical to our success. That's why we're passionate about fostering a high-performance culture built on professional development, open communication, and transparent leadership. If you're smart, dedicated, and eager to help build a market-leading solution that makes a difference in the lives of our clients, join us.

Responsibilities

Serve as the lead point of contact for your assigned accounts, providing exceptional customer service and building strong, long-lasting relationships.
Conduct informational product demos and training to identify opportunities to expand product usage and increase customer retention.
Collaborate with the sales team to identify and grow opportunities within the client base, utilizing your sales disposition and high activity level.
Forecast and track key account metrics, prepare reports on account status, and proactively prevent customer churn.
Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations as needed, demonstrating high impact communication and problem-solving skills.
Attend tradeshows organized by the marketing team, representing One Legal and showcasing our solutions to potential clients.
This is a hybrid role based in our San Francisco office, with regular in-office presence required three days a week

Requirements

2-3 years as a B2B Account Executive or similar, selling software to professional services buyers.
Proven experience in SALES and customer success, account management or relationship sales role, with a track record of achieving sales targets and sustaining client satisfaction.
Knowledge of the legal and conveyancing process is a plus, with experience in a similar role or within the legal technology industry preferred.
A consistent record of over-achievement versus targets and maintaining a healthy sales pipeline.
Good understanding of the consultative sales approach and appreciation of the value of building trust-based relationships with your prospects.
You're a confident communicator and skilled presenter. You enjoy delivering live product demonstrations via video conferencing.
You're technically adept and experienced with web technologies. Ideally, you've previously worked selling SaaS solutions.
Familiarity with the main tools and tactics of selling. You've used a CRM to track and manage your work (ideally Salesforce).

Benefits

At InfoTrack, we're committed to a workplace where everyone feels comfortable to do their best work and, yes, have fun!

We offer:

Excellent health, dental, and vision plans, 401k match, 20 days of paid time off, plus more competitive benefits.

Work with a knowledgeable, high-achieving, experienced, and fun team.

Be part of a culture obsessive about learning, development, and career growth.

Learn more about life at InfoTrack on our website.

InfoTrack is certified as a Great Place to Work®.
